# Gears vertex fixture

This hexadecimal file contains TGSI tokens, vertex attributes, constants and reference vertex outputs captured from the standard Mesa gears demonstration. The test runner decodes it into its temporary output directory. It exercises the VGP instruction encoder against the software vertex results.

Decoded SHA-256: `960eed68829a896a875ce4d9eeedeaabe506ff390859a6ce97189cc4a1388154`.

The fixture contains geometry and shader data. It contains no device identity or radio traffic.
